segments.text_urhobo: Ebraham da reyọ aye ọfa, re se odẹ rọye Kẹtura.

segments.alignment_token: ebraham da reyo aye ofa re se ode roye ketura

segments.text_urhobo: O de vwiẹ Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, kugbe Shua.

segments.text_urhobo: Jokshan kọye ọsẹ ri Sheba kugbe Dedan. Emọ ri Dedan kẹ Asshurim, Letushim kugbe Le-ummim.

segments.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Midian kẹ Ephah, Epher, Hanọk, Abida kugbe Eldah. Enana ejobi na kẹ emọ ri Kẹtura.
segments.text_romanized: emo ri midian ke ephah epher hanok abida kugbe eldah enana ejobi na ke emo ri ketura
segments.alignment_token: emo ri midian ke ephah epher hanok abida kugbe eldah enana ejobi na ke emo ri ketura

segments.text_urhobo: Ebraham da vwẹ emu ro vwori ejobi vwọ kẹ Aizik.
segments.text_romanized: ebraham da vwe emu ro vwori ejobi vwo ke aizik
segments.alignment_token: ebraham da vwe emu ro vwori ejobi vwo ke aizik

segments.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo emọ rẹ ayeobọ na ejobi ẹse kọye o di ru kẹ ayen, ọke rẹ ekpuyovwi rọye vwọ akpọ na ọ da hẹriẹ ayen abọ nẹ oma rẹ Aizik, vwo kpo orho rọ abọ rẹ ọnre da vacha.
segments.text_romanized: ekevuovo emo re ayeobo na ejobi ese koye o di ru ke ayen oke re ekpuyovwi roye vwo akpo na o da herie ayen abo ne oma re aizik vwo kpo orho ro abo re onre da vacha

segments.text_urhobo: Enana keye ẹdẹ rẹ ikpe rẹ akpọ rẹ Ebraham, ikpe iyori nuro vwẹ ujurhiri.

segments.text_urhobo: Ebraham de phi ẹnwẹ họ o de ghwu, ọ ghworo hẹrẹn hẹrẹn, ọmare rọ mrẹ ikpe buebu, o de bru ihwo rọye.

segments.alignment_token: ebraham de phi enwe ho o de ghwu o ghworo heren heren omare ro mre ikpe buebu o de bru ihwo roye

segments.text_urhobo: Aizik kugbe Ishmael rẹ emọ rọye de sho phihọ ẹmwa ri Mak-pela, vwẹ otọ ri Ephron ọmọ ri Zohar rẹ ohwo ri Hẹt, rọ obọrhe ri Mamre,
segments.text_romanized: aizik kugbe ishmael re emo roye de sho phiho emwa ri mak pela vwe oto ri ephron omo ri zohar re ohwo ri het ro oborhe ri mamre
segments.alignment_token: aizik kugbe ishmael re emo roye de sho phiho emwa ri mak pela vwe oto ri ephron omo ri zohar re ohwo ri het ro oborhe ri mamre

segments.text_urhobo: otọ rẹ Ebraham dẹ mie ihwo ri Hẹt. Etiyin kọye e shi Ebraham phihọ kugbe Sera rẹ aye rọye.
segments.text_romanized: oto re ebraham de mie ihwo ri het etiyin koye e shi ebraham phiho kugbe sera re aye roye
segments.alignment_token: oto re ebraham de mie ihwo ri het etiyin koye e shi ebraham phiho kugbe sera re aye roye

segments.text_urhobo: Rẹ Ebraham vwo ghwunu Ọghẹnẹ de bruphihọ kẹ Aizik rẹ ọmọ rọye. Aizik da dia Beer-lahai-roi.

segments.alignment_token: re ebraham vwo ghwunu oghene de bruphiho ke aizik re omo roye aizik da dia beer lahai roi

segments.text_urhobo: Enana keye uvwiẹ rẹ Ishmael, ọmọ rẹ Ebraham, ri Hagar rẹ ohwo rẹ Ijipt, rẹ ọviẹn ri Sera, vwiẹ kẹ Ebraham.

segments.alignment_token: enana keye uvwie re ishmael omo re ebraham ri hagar re ohwo re ijipt re ovien ri sera vwie ke ebraham

segments.text_urhobo: Enana edẹ rẹ emọ rẹ Ishmael, re vwiẹri ohwohwo kpahe ohwo: Nebaioth, ọmọ ọkpako rẹ Ishmael, kugbe Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

segments.text_urhobo: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, kugbe Kedemah.

segments.alignment_token: hadad tema jetur naphish kugbe kedemah

segments.text_urhobo: Enana keye emọ rẹ Ishmael, enana keye odẹ rayen, ọkuọko rayen kugbe orho rayen, ivie ihwivẹ kirobo rẹ ẹgborho rayen epha.

segments.text_urhobo: Ayen da dia nẹ Havilah rhi te Shur, ro hirhe opharo ku Ijipt vwẹ ọke re de kpo Asiria; ọ da dia hirhe uko ku ihwo rọye.

segments.text_urhobo: Aizik ghwo te ikpe ujuvẹ, tavwe ọ ke reyọ Rebeka vwọ rọvwọ, ọmọtẹ ri Bẹtuẹl ohwo rẹ Aram rẹ orere ri Padanaram, oniọvo ri Laban rẹ ohwo rẹ Aram.

segments.text_urhobo: Aizik da nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ Ọghẹnẹ fiki rẹ aye rọye, kidie ẹga oruẹ, Ọrovwohwo de nyo ẹrhovwo rọye, Rebeka rẹ aye rọye da rhi mrevun.

segments.text_urhobo: Emọ na ki phre vwẹ evun na, o da ta, Ọ da dia enẹ, kidie Me guọnọ vwẹ akpọ? Etiyin o de re duotọ rọye vwẹ obọ rẹ Ọrovwohwo.

segments.text_urhobo: Ọrovwohwo da ta kẹ, Ẹgborho ivẹ ri evun wẹn, oka rẹ ihwo ivẹ, ru wo che vwiẹ na, ke ghare oma; Ọvo cha goma nọ ọrivẹ, oro ọkpako cha ga oro otete.

segments.text_urhobo: Orẹ ẹsosuọ vwo shotọ ọvwara wei, oma rọye ejobi ẹtuẹnto yafu, kọye e de se odẹ rọye Isọ.

segments.text_urhobo: Emerha oniọvo rọye de rhi shotọ, ọ da vwẹ obọ yọnrọn uchuku owọ rẹ Isọ, Etiyin e de se odẹ rọye Jekọp. Aizik ikpe ujorha vwẹ ọke ro vwo vwiẹ emọ na.

segments.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ emọ na vwọ ghwanre re, Isọ kẹ ọgba oruẹ, ohwo rẹ aghwa, Jekọp kẹ ohwo dẹndẹn rọ dia itughẹ.

segments.text_urhobo: Ivun rẹ Isọ vwerhe Aizik gangan, fikiridie o hwe eranvwe kẹ na; ẹkẹvuọvo ivun ri Jekọp da rha vwerhe Rebeka.
